'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Opa, hey there! So listen up, there's this big chemist guy in the city. Makes all kinds of fucked-up drugs. And there's a rumor going around that he created some new stimulant. The bums say they saw a jacked-up PMC merc running around the block like a fucking lunatic, dodging bullets Neo style. But then he tripped over a rock and gone to forever sleep, can you believe it? Looks like that chemo took a toll on his health. There's a price to pay for everything in life... Find out what kind of drugs he was stoned on and if there's any reason to peddle that shit.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 20 PMC operatives while under the influence of the [[Obdolbos cocktail injector|"Obdolbos" cocktail]]

==Rewards==
* [[Skier]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.15'''</font>
* 1× [[SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope]] at [[Skier]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope]] at [[Skier]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[EOTech Vudu 1-6x24 30mm riflescope]] at [[Skier]] LL1
{{Quote|The fuck? You sure the chemist ain't messing with the ingredients? Anyway, well done. Here's your reward.}}

==Failure Dialogue==
{{quote|What, couldn't test it right? Well shit, do it again then. While the body's young and strong.}}
